verified_title: JEPA-kMMVAE: CSI Prediction for Time-Varying Wireless Channels
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2610.13315: JEPA-kMMVAE: CSI Prediction for Time-Varying Wireless Channels
method_summary: A stochastic latent Markov model with finite-memory Gaussian posterior handles noisy CSI history. JEPA prediction uses the pretrained kMMVAE encoder; only historical noisy observations are inputs, while clean future CSI remains a training/evaluation target. Residual correction is an option.
direct_overlap: wireless JEPA plus stochastic latent dynamics
evidence_and_limits: CSI simulation rather than packet-level control; the abstract reports sequence baselines stronger under some strong-noise settings. Combining JEPA, stochastic latents and a residual is not itself new.
